metas.name: 1 · ★ 5.4 · 1992 · 3 Ninjas
metas.description: Each year, three brothers visit their grandfather for the summer. He is highly skilled in ninjutsu, and for years he has trained the boys in his techniques.

metas.name: 2 · ★ 4.7 · 1994 · 3 Ninjas Kick Back
metas.description: Young martial artists face their grandfather's foes when they accompany him to Japan to deliver a priceless dagger.

metas.name: 3 · ★ 4.4 · 1995 · 3 Ninjas: Knuckle Up
metas.description: Rocky, Colt and Tum Tum are back in an all new adventure everyone will fall for.

metas.name: 4 · ★ 3.1 · 1998 · 3 Ninjas: High Noon at Mega Mountain
metas.description: The three unstoppable Ninja brothers fight to save their hero (Hulk Hogan) and Mega Mountain Amusement Park from the vicious kid-hating Medusa (Loni Anderson).
